title: Geometric realization of $W$-operators
summary: Certain integrable hierarchies appearing in random matrix theory, enumerative geometry, and conformal field theory are governed by Virasoro/$W$-algebra constraints and their $W$-representations.Motivated by the Gaussian Hermitian $β$-ensemble and recent studies of superintegrable partition function hierarchies, we build an explicit bridge from symmetric group class algebras to bosonic Fock spaces and further to geometry.
